entry.name: jit.traffic
entry.digest: Multiply the planar vector by a matrix
entry.description: The jit.traffic object takes an input matrix and multiplies its cells using an N x N+1 float32 matrix (where N is the planecount of the input matrix). The left input matrix can be of any type.
